steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Just as you expected, Zoya went down by the central elevator on her own. Earl is guarding the entrance.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The underground situation is precarious for them as well. The Legion can't spare anyone to come and stop you.
Did they release these two to save you so that the shackles can be preserved and they can let others help finish off the remaining gangsters?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: To remove the Legion's control over Chief, we must get in touch with the Bureau before Zoya comes back from underground. We must look for ways to disable Earl's power.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let's go, Hella. We should leave this place.
At least until Zoya returns from underground, you will still be safe and free. You've never been closer to the target.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Inheritance</color>... We still have the inheritance... The voodoo's will lies there, the path she takes is filled with traps. Thou Voodoos will bring divine punishment to them...

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos
steps.content: Go to... <color=#fb9259>the second downward well</color>, the path closer to the inheritance... It's <color=#fb9259>here</color>...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But...
You kick open the weapon box left behind by the gangsters. They're still filled with Mania weapons.
According to Ted, Mania Crystal is a rare commodity, yet the gangsters here each have one of these. It's they who are distributing the weapons and spreading rumors about the inheritance.
Who are they? What do they have to do with the inheritance and the Mania crisis?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait... I... recognize this stuff.
She picks up the weapon box cracked open by the gangsters. It holds a broken jar with some blood-red liquid left inside.
A ring is printed on one spot, with a letter <color=#fb9259>P</color> marked in the center of the ring.

options: Is this a Mania Crystal in its liquid state?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... That's not what it's called... I understand now, I should have recognized it sooner...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mania Crystals are extracted from Sinners' bodies. This is an experiment done by those bastards...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But why is it here... They have already...
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The intense shaking interrupts your question, like a massive heartbeat coming from underground. You've never felt the inheritance's presence so strongly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, let go!
The Nightmare knocks off the jar in Hella's hand. It smashes on the ground and suddenly lets out countless black spikes. They're wriggling and reproducing rapidly like living things.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Who knew that tiny piece of Mania Crystal can turn into such a big one...
The ground beneath you suddenly crumbles. Countless longer and sharper contamination spikes are crashing through the concrete floor. You are falling down into a mezzanine level.
There are more weapon boxes with the letter P piled up here. Now, they're all bursting open from within and the contamination is pouring out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why is it here? Haven't they all...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are they here for her?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella! Focus! Fight!
Filthy monsters are emerging one after another from the wriggling contamination!
